run_fill_mask_pipeline: run the FillMaskPipeline to predict tokens for a sentence containing a single MASK token
create_fill_mask_pipeline: create a FillMaskPipeline instance using a model ID from the HuggingFace Hub
review_fill_mask_call: review the FillMaskPipeline call method that returns token predictions with scores and sequences
test_fill_mask_pipeline: test the FillMaskPipeline by passing a masked sentence and verifying the returned list of token predictions
summarize_fill_mask_output: summarize the FillMaskPipeline output containing sequence, score, token id, and token string for each prediction
